Hi Elena — thanks, and welcome. To complete vendor master entry we need the following canonical items: legal name, entity type (LLC/C-Corp/etc), tax ID (EIN or foreign equivalent), registered office address for legal/contracting, primary AP remit email, primary PO contact (name/email/phone), W-9 or W-8/W-9 equivalent, and the certificate of incorporation (or Articles) as you provided. If you have a preferred billing address separate from the registered office, please include that.

I've attached our standard Vendor Onboarding form to capture these fields and a short checklist for PO routing and 1099 handling. If you prefer, you can upload the completed form to the secure link below. Once we receive the completed form and tax docs, AP will provision a vendor code (Vendor ID) and set default PO routing.

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Redwood.docx (fillable, 120KB)
Secure upload link: https://secure.redwood.com/onboard/solstice/8342

Next steps I propose:
- Elena: return filled form + W-9/W-8 (or confirmation if not applicable)
- AP (cc Vanessa): verify banking info and confirm remit channel (ACH/wire/email)
- Procurement (cc Karthik): confirm preferred invoicing/PO process (PO required, blanket PO, or email-only)

I'll hold the onboarding until we get the completed packet — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if any of these items need clarification.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Manager, Vendor Operations
